prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, 6-band horizontal multi-material body, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Romanian woman in Balkan glam makeup — warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, long dark-brown hair in glossy voluminous waves, an intense, proud expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a thick gold hoop with a gold coin drop.

Physique: Her waist cinched to an impossible minimum, making the contrast with the enormous rear utterly extreme: the rear and hips flare to more than four times the width of that narrow waist, an enormous rounded rear projecting far out behind her and merging into the lower back and thighs as one continuous mass, a moderate chest, slim shoulders, left arm crystal, right arm stone, torso/hip/thigh-stubs in 6 stepped horizontal bands.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent milky moonstone, never hollow. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque, completely opaque.

Torso, hips and both thigh-stubs (excluding arms): 6 equal horizontal bands, stacked top to bottom, each with a raised stepped edge and shadow at its border, no gaps, no skin. Band 1 (torso/hip band 1): carved solid vivid violet-purple purpleheart wood, completely opaque. Band 2 (torso/hip band 2): carved solid golden teak with fine straight grain, completely opaque. Band 3 (torso/hip band 3): carved solid warm cream-to-tan olive wood with dark swirling grain, completely opaque. Band 4 (torso/hip band 4): carved solid vivid orange-red Osage orange wood, completely opaque. Band 5 (torso/hip band 5): carved solid dark chocolate-brown bocote wood with bold tiger-stripe patterns, completely opaque. Band 6 (both thigh-stubs, a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be): carved solid striking orange-red padauk wood, completely opaque, rounding off at both tips.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep violet on one side and a cool silver on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so violet light glances off one side and silver light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
